scientific_role: Blind graph-prediction execution contract after the V3b provider-selection freeze and mechanical audit, before any V3b graph prediction or final graph white-box evaluation.

eligibility.source: frozen Step-0 eligibility only; runner must read the eligibility manifest/table rather than re-evaluate Step-0
eligibility.failure_policy: GATE_FAILED_STEP0 cells receive no graph prediction and are not repaired, recalibrated, or replaced.

removed_v2_diagnostic.reason: The old diagnostic is tied to the V2 48-point LHS candidate bank and no longer isolates a meaningful scoring contrast in the seven-candidate V3b reconstruction.

M0.definition: unchanged frozen analytic topology-aware same-rho product baseline

M1.provider_models: V3b RMSE rank-1 candidate for each provider

M2.provider_models: V3b RMSE ranks 1..3 for each provider
M2.point_prediction: equal-weight mean of the 27 joint-model sigma curves

descriptive_spread.minimum: pointwise minimum across the 27 joint-model sigma curves
descriptive_spread.maximum: pointwise maximum across the 27 joint-model sigma curves
descriptive_spread.interpretation: finite spread among combinations of the three best local provider reconstructions; not a confidence interval, posterior credible interval, or deliberately diversity-maximized range

M3.provider_models: all seven frozen V3 candidates per provider
M3.provider_weights: unchanged frozen V3 Jeffreys-smoothed Bernoulli-KL Gibbs weights with lambda=30
M3.rank_rule: descending full-support joint product weight with deterministic existing V3/V3b rank order

allocation.objective: minimize the query-independent worst-case Bernoulli Monte-Carlo variance bound (1/4)*sum_j(alpha_j^2/N_j)
allocation.weights: alpha_j are the provider-world-specific full-support joint weights renormalized within ranks 1..14
allocation.integer_rule: initialize N_j=1 for all 14 ranks, then assign each remaining trajectory to the rank maximizing alpha_j^2/[N_j*(N_j+1)]
allocation.allocation_scope: computed once per provider world from that world's frozen Top14 weights and then reused unchanged across all eligible graph cells in that provider world

nested_readouts.Top1: rank 1 only, weight renormalized to 1, using the rank-1 trajectory count from that provider world's frozen Top14 B=1400 allocation
nested_readouts.Top3: ranks 1..3, original frozen joint weights renormalized within Top3, using each rank's trajectory count from that provider world's frozen Top14 B=1400 allocation
nested_readouts.Top14: ranks 1..14, original frozen joint weights renormalized within Top14, using that provider world's full frozen B=1400 allocation

diagnostics: plugin Monte-Carlo variance and standard error
worst-case Monte-Carlo variance and standard-error bound
M3.immutability: No graph result may alter candidate identities, provider weights, joint ranks, retained support, allocation, lambda, or budget.

M1_M2.common_random_numbers: same 100-seed bank reused across M1, every M2 joint model, and every eligible physical cell

M3.rank_seed_rule: rank r uses seed_base+(r-1)*seed_block_stride+k for k=0..N_r-1
M3.prefix_rule_when_allocations_differ: if provider-world allocations give different N_r, each cell uses the prefix of the same rank-r stream required by its frozen provider-world allocation

queries.source: each eligible cell's frozen Step-0 step0_frozen_queries.csv

global_prediction_freeze.final_whitebox_gate: No final-WB file may be generated or opened until the global V3b prediction-freeze manifest is successfully frozen.

graph_prediction_may_read: frozen Step-0 query definitions for eligible cells
frozen V3/V3b reconstruction parameters, identities, weights and supports
graph_prediction_must_not_read: Step-0 white-box calibration/confirmation outcome values other than eligibility and frozen query definitions
final graph white-box ledgers or curves

execution_gate: A registered V3b real graph-adapter smoke using engineering-only seeds must pass after this contract is frozen and before any scientific V3b graph prediction is executed.
